title: Monoamine Oxidase Activity in Fish Brain Tissue
author: Caio Maximino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgu9jwz6
materials: Start reaction by adding 110 micromolar (µM) kynuramine hydrobromide in a final volume of 700 µL. Kynuramine hydrobromide Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #K3250
Concentration should be estimated with a standard curve of 4-hydroxyquinoline (4-Quinolinol) 4-Hydroxyquinoline (4-Quinolinol) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #H58005

steps.title: Prepare tissue lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a tissue lysis buffer consisting of 16.8 mM Na2HPO4 and 10.6 mM KH2PO4, pH 7.4, isotonized with sucrose.

steps.title: Prepare assay buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare an assay buffer consisting of 168 mM Na2HPO4 and 10.6 mM KH2PO4, pH 7.4, isotonized with KCl.

steps.title: Collect and process brain tissue
steps.instruction: Euthanize fish in ice-cold water (<12 ºC) and dissect brains in tissue lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Pool two brains per sample unit.

steps.title: Centrifuge tissue samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples on 0.5 mL tissue lysis buffer at 1,000 x g for 5 min.

steps.title: Reserve supernatants
steps.instruction: Reserve the supernatants for assays and maintain them on ice throughout the experiment.

steps.title: Preincubate protein samples
steps.instruction: Mix protein samples (approximately 100 µg) with 460 µL of assay buffer and preincubate at 37 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Incubate reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the final solution for 30 min.

steps.title: Stop the reaction
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction by adding 300 µL of 10% volume trichloroacetic acid (TCA).

steps.title: Centrifuge and neutralize products
steps.instruction: Centrifuge reaction products at 16,000 x g for 5 min, then mix 800 µL of the supernatants with 1 mL of 1 M NaOH.

steps.title: Prepare for fluorescence measurement
steps.instruction: Transfer the centrifuged, NaOH-buffered reaction products to quartz cuvettes and place the cuvettes into a spectrofluorophotometer.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure fluorescence using excitation at 315 nm and emission at 380 nm.

steps.title: Calculate enzyme activity
steps.instruction: Calculate enzyme activity as nmol 4-OH quinoline/min/mg protein.

substeps.instruction: Determine protein concentration using the Bradford or (preferably) Lowry assays.
